描述_EN: coloured silk panels such as this were woven as quilt covers, and this example has a paper label glued to it which describes it as being for this purpose. this cover has a blue satin ground brocaded in several colours and gold with five four-toed dragons surrounded by the attributes of the daoist eight immortals and by buddhist and other emblematic motifs. chinese beds sometimes have two or three such quilts neatly folded and stacked up at one end during the day.
描述_ZN: 像这样的彩色丝板被编织成被套，这个例子有一个纸质标签粘在上面，说明它是用于这个目的。 这个被子有一个蓝色的缎子地，上面有几个颜色和金色的五条四趾龙，周围有道教八仙的属性以及佛教和其他象征性的图案。 中国的床上有时会有两到三条这样的被子，在白天整齐地折叠并堆放在一端。
